title: BlueOak Logistics outbound scratch
content:
Quick context:
- Account: BlueOak Logistics (mid-market 3PL, cross-border freight + last-mile). HQ in Portland, CA. ~450 employees, Series B in 2023. Tech-forward ops team (recent hiring for data platform).
- Why target: high volume customer support / exceptions, clear ROI for LLM assistants (reduction in TTR and manual triage). Potential pilot scope: exception triage agent + standardized customer response generator + embedding-based search over SOPs.
- Primary hypothesis: a lightweight Redwood-hosted pilot (hosted API) proving 30% faster TTR and 20% fewer human escalations can convert to Dedicated reservation in quarter 2.

Stakeholders (mapped roughly):
- Head of Operations: "Maya Patel" (likely economic buyer) — quoted in blog post about automation.
- Director of Customer Experience: "Tobias Reed" (technical-ish, cares about CSAT).
- Platform/Eng manager: "Sana Kapoor" (would own integration and data ops).
- Security contact: "Jacob Lin" (infosec) — flagged in job posts as compliance focus.

Competitive signals / intel:
- They use Segment + Snowflake + Zendesk (from job descriptions & S3 footprint).
- Job posting for "AI Integrations Engineer" (Feb 2026) — suggests pilot interest.
- Recently attended SupplyChainAI conference (May 2025) — slides posted on personal LinkedIn (Tobias).

Potential value props to emphasize:
- Low-friction pilot: Redwood hosted API + small prompt set, 2-week eval with staging dataset. No infra for BO to provision up-front.
- Predictable economics: show token-level cost simulation for their typical conversation volumes.
- Security-first options: private deployment / VPC for PII-sensitive flows, KMS/HSM integrations for keys.
- Fallback & reliability: canary routing to smaller model variant to keep SLA during spikes.

Outbound play (first-touch cadence):
1) LinkedIn top-line: 1–2 short lines, callout to their post about automation, include 1-sentence value statement + ask for 10–15m to share a small pilot idea.
2) Email follow-up: longer note with a concrete time-boxed pilot proposal and short case study from similar 3PL (anonymized).
3) If no reply, send a short POV doc (1-pager PDF) with sample flows and cost estimate.

LinkedIn message (draft):
- Hi Maya — loved your post about automating exception workflows at BlueOak. I work at Redwood Inference (we help ops teams ship LLM assistants with production-grade latency and predictable unit costs). Would you be open to a quick 15m to run a two-week pilot idea that targets 30% faster triage for your exceptions?

Cold email (draft - subject variations below):
Subject options: "Pilot idea: 2-week LLM pilot for BlueOak exceptions" | "Reduce exception TTR by 30% — pilot" | "Quick pilot for BlueOak ops team"
Body:
Hi Maya —
I’m Alyssa from Redwood Inference. We help teams like yours ship LLM-powered assistants that reduce manual handling of exceptions and speed up customer responses while keeping costs predictable.

We’ve sketched a 2-week pilot for BlueOak that would:
- Plug into Zendesk + your SOP docs (embeddings)
- Auto-draft responses for common exception cases + surface the right SOP snippet to agents
- Measure TTR and escalation rate against a small sample of tickets

No infra required from your side for the pilot — Redwood hosted API + ephemeral dataset. If this sounds useful I can send a 1-pager and a short cost estimate. 15m next week to review?

— Alyssa

Call script bullets (prep for discovery):
- Opening: reference Maya's post; quick intro to Redwood and one-sentence value prop.
- Confirm pain: "How many exception tickets per day? Avg TTR? Biggest pain points?"
- Data/tech: "Where do you store SOPs? Zendesk + Snowflake? Any PII concerns?"
- Pilot ask: "We run a two-week pilot on sample tickets — we’ll need a SME for 2–3hrs total and a sandbox Zendesk key."
- Close: propose specific time and next steps.

Objection handling (short notes):
- "We worry about security/PII": Redwood hosted pilot uses encrypted transport; offer dedicated/private deployment for escalation path; outline KMS/HSM and SOC2 details + HIPAA conversation if needed. Offer to sign NDA.
- "Costs are unclear": show token-level example for 1000 tickets/day, delta cost vs. agent time saved; show dedicated reservation vs. pay-as-you-go breakeven.
- "Not enough engineering bandwidth": propose product-driven integration pattern (Zapier-like webhook + small Lambda) with Redwood prebuilt connector for Zendesk; offer professional services to run first integration.
- "LLM hallucinations / accuracy": propose evaluation metrics + human-in-the-loop verification for first 500 outputs, rollback plan and threshold for production rollout.

Pilot success metrics (suggested):
- Primary: mean TTR reduction (target 30% on pilot bucket)
- Secondary: % tickets auto-drafted accepted without edit, reduction in escalations, CSAT for pilot group
- Operational: cost per ticket, 95th percentile latency for generation under 500ms target (for agent flow)

Minimal pilot plan (2 weeks):
- Day 0–2: data ingestion & mapping (SOP scraping, sample ticket selection)
- Day 3–6: embed + retrieval config, prompt engineering with ops SME
- Day 7–10: small sandbox test, iterate on prompts, add safety heuristics
- Day 11–14: live pilot on subset of tickets, measure & present results

Open questions / to-do (personal):
- Get an intro to Maya — is warm intro via LinkedIn connection of Jon Rivera possible? Jon previously worked with similar accounts.
- Find anonymized case study (3PL or logistics) to reference — ask Priya for lead.
- Estimate token costs: need sample ticket dump (500 tickets) to simulate.
- Draft 1-pager (POV + cost table) — assign to me, due 2026-03-12.

Notes to self / rough thoughts:
- Could pitch add-on: agent search + routing (if they want to auto-assign to regional hubs) — upsell to Dedicated.
- If security pushback, propose two-phase: hosted pilot (no PII sample), then Private eval for PII-laden cases.
- Keep messaging pragmatic: "reduce friction for agents, not replace them" — call out human-in-the-loop ops improvements.

Short checklist before outreach:
- [ ] Confirm champion (Maya) contact info
- [ ] 1-pager deck v1
- [ ] Sim cost table for 500/1k/5k tickets per day
- [ ] Internal sync with PS for integration readiness

Timestamped edits:
- 2026-03-01 09:12 — added call script bullets after quick node with Jon.
- 2026-03-08 14:05 — updated pilot metrics to include latency target per Alyssa.

End.
